convert_to_tensor: convert numpy arrays, sequences, ints, and floats to torch tensors using to_tensor
use_Tensor_pipeline: use the ToTensor pipeline class to convert specified result dict keys to torch tensors
convert_image_to_tensor: use ImageToTensor to convert HWC images to CHW torch tensors with automatic dimension expansion
format_detection_results: use DefaultFormatBundle to format img, gt_bboxes, gt_labels, gt_masks, and gt_semantic_seg fields
collect_pipeline_data: use Collect to gather specified keys and img_meta into a data dict for model input
